display.title: T2: Stand Up Power
display.subtitle: A dynamo and somewhere to store it
description: Machines past Tier 1 run on §bRedstone Flux§r. Build a generator and a
buffer so your smelting line never starves.
Build a §bStirling§r or §bMagmatic Dynamo§r for power, and a §bRedstone
Flux Cell§r to bank it. Having a dynamo in hand completes this beat.
§7Power infrastructure is the backbone of every later tier - the Mekanism
5x chain and the T4 reactors all draw from a grid you start building here.
